title: Check if the array is sorted
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Check whether an array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
intuition: Sortedness is a local property: it holds iff every adjacent pair is in order.

approaches.title: Brute: compare all pairs
approaches.idea: Check a[i] <= a[j] for every i < j.

approaches.title: Optimal: adjacent scan with early exit
approaches.idea: One inversion in adjacent positions is enough to answer False.
approaches.code:
def is_sorted(a: list[int]) -> bool:
    return all(a[i] <= a[i + 1] for i in range(len(a) - 1))
approaches.whyWorks: Transitivity: adjacent ordering chains into global ordering.

edgeCases: Duplicates must be allowed for non-decreasing
commonMistakes: Using `<` and rejecting valid arrays with duplicates
interviewInsight: The follow-up "sorted and rotated?" is the real question — at most one drop is allowed.
